values: 移动至目标格子，随后将周围的敌人击退，若敌人产生碰撞则会造成额外伤害与眩晕。
Rushes to the selected target and knocks back nearby enemies, dealing extra damage and stunning them if they collide with other entities.
选择一个格子，迅速移动至该位置，随后用长棍猛挥一圈，对周围1格范围内的所有敌人造成250% + 10% ATK伤害并将其击退1格。如果目标在被击退的过程中碰撞到任意角色、地形阻挡或战场边界，则额外受到400% + 20% ATK伤害并被眩晕2.5秒。自动释放时，本技能优先选择能使尽可能多的目标产生碰撞的格子释放。

Soren selects a tile and rushes there to swing his weapon, dealing 250% + 10% ATK damage to adjacent enemies and knocking them back 1 tile. If the targets collide with allies, enemies, terrain, or battlefield borders along their path, they take 400% + 20% ATK damage and are stunned for 2.5s. This skill prioritizes targeting the tile that will cause the most enemies to collide when cast automatically.
被本技能击退的敌人，如果碰撞到了另一名敌人，则也会对后者造成400% + 20% ATK伤害与2.5秒的眩晕效果。
Soren deals 400% + 20% ATK damage and stuns another enemy for 2.5s if the target knocked back by this skill collides with them.
碰撞产生的额外伤害提高至410% + 20% ATK。
Increases the collision damage to 410% + 20% ATK.
碰撞产生的额外伤害提高至420% + 20% ATK。
Increases the collision damage to 420% + 20% ATK.
碰撞产生的额外伤害提高至430% + 20% ATK。
Increases the collision damage to 430% + 20% ATK.
对一名目标造成伤害并将其击退，若产生碰撞则会造成额外伤害与眩晕。
Deals damage to a target and knocks them back, dealing additional damage and stunning them upon collision.
挥动长棍，对一名近战范围内的敌人造成180% + 10% ATK伤害，并将其击退1格。如果目标在被击退的过程中碰撞到任意角色、地形阻挡或战场边界，则额外受到250% + 20% ATK伤害并被眩晕1.5秒。释放该技能时，索恩会尝试向左右调整自己的位置，从而尽可能使目标产生碰撞。

Soren swings his weapon to deal 180% + 10% ATK damage to an enemy in melee range, knocking them back 1 tile. If the target collides with allies, enemies, terrain, or battlefield borders along their path, they take 250% + 20% ATK damage and are stunned for 1.5s. Soren repositions himself to ensure maximum collisions between targets when casting this skill.
额外的碰撞伤害提高至270% + 20% ATK。
Increases the collision damage to 270% + 20% ATK.
产生碰撞后，目标的眩晕时间延长至2秒。
Extends the stun duration upon collision to 2s.
单次受到较高伤害时，格挡伤害并刷新技能“掠阵疾袭”的冷却时间。
Blocks a powerful single attack and resets the cooldown of Repel Sweep.
当受到超过自身最大生命值10%的单次伤害时，索恩会灵巧地使用卸力技巧进行格挡，使本次伤害降低70%，并立即刷新技能“掠阵疾袭”的冷却时间。本效果每7 − 1秒最多触发一次。
Soren reduces the damage taken from a single attack that exceeds 10% of his max HP by 70%, resetting the cooldown of Repel Sweep. This effect can be triggered once every 7 − 1s.
本技能降低伤害的比例提升至80%。
Increases the DMG Reduction ratio to 80%.
本技能降低伤害的比例提升至90%。
Increases the DMG Reduction ratio to 90%.
本技能的触发间隔缩短至6 − 1秒。
战斗中，自身的急速提升12点。
战斗中，自身的急速提升16点。
战斗中，自身的急速提升20点。
生命值较低时强化自身，提升急速值并恢复生命值与能量。
Increases Haste and recovers HP and Energy when his HP is low.
当自身的生命值百分比低于60%时，索恩激活神秘力量强化自身，使自己提升60点急速，并且每秒恢复4%最大生命值与40点能量，持续12秒。本效果每场战斗只能触发1次。
Soren gains 60 Haste and recovers 4% of max HP and 40 Energy per second for 12s when his HP ratio is below 60%. This effect can only be triggered once per battle.
本技能在战斗中可以多次触发，但有25秒的触发间隔。每次触发本技能时，索恩还会清除身上的全部控制状态。
Soren removes all active control effects when this skill is triggered. It can be triggered repeatedly in a single battle, with a cooldown of 25s.
技能生效期间，额外获得的急速值提高至80点。
Increases the bonus Haste to 80 while this skill is active.
技能生效期间，每秒生命恢复量提高至5%最大生命值。
Increases the HP recovery to 5% of the max HP per second while this skill is active.
通过技能“拨挡遁身”格挡伤害后，下一次释放“掠阵疾袭”时的击退距离提升，并附带额外伤害。
After Deflecting Swing is triggered, the next Repel Sweep knocks enemies back farther and deals bonus damage.
当技能“拨挡遁身”触发后，下一次释放技能“掠阵疾袭”时的击退距离提升至2格，并附带本次格挡掉的伤害量50%的额外伤害。
After Deflecting Swing is triggered, the next Repel Sweep knocks enemies back 2 tiles and deals bonus damage equal to 50% of the damage blocked.
释放技能“风影旋舞”“掠阵疾袭”使目标在被击退的过程中碰撞到任意角色、地形阻挡或战场边界时，回复80点能量，并且立刻获得抵御值等同于自身100% ATK攻击力的护盾，持续到战斗结束，并且还会刷新技能“拨挡遁身”的冷却时间。该效果在一次技能释放中至多触发1次。

If an enemy hit by Whirlwind Swing or Repel Sweep collides with any unit, terrain, or battlefield boundaries while being knocked back, restores 80 Energy to Soren. This also grants Soren a shield equal to 100% ATK for the rest of the battle and refreshes the cooldown of Deflecting Swing. This effect can be triggered once per skill cast.
